note: Both sets contain the same seven claims with identical values, bindings, and supporting quotes, all of which are faithful to the page text (47,402.91 N•m saturation, 15,000 N•m/s rate limit, 1173.7 rpm rated speed, high drivetrain damping, no torsional-vibration control loop, single-DOF = shaft angular rotation, and the blade-pitch control goal). The only difference is that Set A adds the condition 'Region 3' to the rated generator speed claim, which is a reasonable contextual qualifier since the value appears in the Region 3 pitch-control discussion, though rated speed is not strictly a Region-3-only property. Neither set invents values or misbinds attributes, and both omit the same minor facts (e.g., the 1° blade-pitch trigger and 10% above rated).
